# group_events

A table. append-only added|removed|touched events per (group, identity)

## Columns

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | PRIMARY KEY |
| `group_id` | TEXT | NOT NULL REFERENCES groups(id) |
| `identity_id` | TEXT | NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id) |
| `event` | TEXT | NOT NULL |
| `detail` | TEXT |  |
| `run_id` | TEXT |  |
| `created_at` | TEXT | NOT NULL |

## Definition

From `spec/ledger.sql`, which is the machine-checkable form of SPEC.md §3:

```sql
CREATE TABLE group_events (
  id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- ULID
  group_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES groups(id),
  identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id),
  event       TEXT NOT NULL,             -- 'added' | 'removed' | 'touched'
  detail      TEXT,                      -- JSON provenance
  run_id      TEXT,                      -- nullable: hand edits have no run
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX ix_ge_lookup ON group_events(group_id, identity_id, event, created_at DESC);
```
